about: Country figures for the AI World Map (pages/ai-world-map.html). Every value comes from the source named on its layer; sec 1 = read from a secondary reproduction of the primary report (shown with ⚠️). Countries not listed have no figure in that source, which is not the same as zero.

layers.title: Private AI investment, 2024
layers.source: Stanford AI Index 2025, Economy chapter (Quid data), as charted by Statista
layers.note: US, China and UK figures also appear in the AI Index text ($109.1B, $9.3B, $4.5B). The 2026 edition (2025 data) was not yet read country by country.

layers.title: Newly funded AI companies, 2024
layers.source: Stanford AI Index 2025 (Quid data), as reproduced in a MUFG Americas chart
layers.note: Top 10 countries only. The AI Index 2026 reports 2025 counts of 1,953 (US), 172 (UK) and 161 (China).

layers.title: Notable AI models by country of the developing institution, 2024
layers.source: Stanford AI Index 2025, Research & Development chapter (Epoch AI data)
layers.note: Europe's three notable models all came from France (IEEE Spectrum's summary of the report).

layers.title: Share of tracked AI supercomputer (GPU cluster) performance, May 2025
layers.source: Epoch AI, AI supercomputers dataset: performance share by country
layers.note: Epoch's dataset covers roughly 10–20% of global AI compute, and it warns shares could differ by 5+ points. The EU as a bloc is around 5% in secondary reports (not shown per country).

layers.title: Share of global AI journal publications, 2023
layers.source: Stanford AI Index 2025, Research & Development chapter
layers.note: Only China and India have country shares in the text we could read; Europe as a region holds 15.2%. The US share (stable until 2021, slightly declining since) was not stated as a number, so it is left blank rather than guessed. Total AI publications: about 242,000 in 2023.

layers.title: Model releases tracked on this site, by lab headquarters
layers.source: This site's Model Release Map (each release links its own source); lab → headquarters country is our assignment
layers.note: Counts every release in our dataset (LLM, image, video, speech, world models), Jun 2017 → Nov 2026. Google DeepMind is counted under the United States (parent company), although DeepMind is headquartered in London. BigScience (an international collaboration) is not counted. ElevenLabs (offices in New York and London) is counted under the United States.
